meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩记忆文件为精简格式,节省输入令牌
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常感觉上下文空间不够,想减少大模型费用
copy.tagline_en: Compress memory files into a compact form to save tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run out of context space and want to cut AI costs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按命令把 .md、.txt 等自然语言记忆文件改写成简短粗犷的“caveman”风格，原样保留代码、链接、路径等技术内容，压缩后覆盖原文件，并在系统数据目录留一份可读备份。
howto.when: 当你说“/caveman-compress 文件路径”，或要求压缩记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md、偏好文件）时触发。

say.note: Claude 会改写并备份原文件

say.text: 把 preferences.md 压缩成 caveman 格式
压缩我记的 todo 文件，别动里面的代码
say.note: 代码和结构会原样保留

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude rewrites natural-language memory files (.md, .txt, etc.) into terse caveman style, preserving code, URLs, paths, and structure. The compressed version overwrites the original, and a readable backup is stored in the system data directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/caveman-compress <filepath>" or ask to compress a memory file (e.g., CLAUDE.md, preferences).

say_en.note: Claude rewrites and backs up the file

say_en.text: Compress my todo file, don't touch the code inside
